title: Restore & Pamper Retreat at Polperro Farmhouse
summary: 3-day, 2-night wellness retreat at Polperro Farmhouse in Red Hill. Yoga, massage at PHS or Endota, optional juice cleanse, at the farmhouse in Red Hill. Booked direct via Polperro or Hut Yoga.
bookingRequired: Yes, contact Polperro or Hut Yoga
priceRange: Varies with inclusions (accommodation + programme; additional services extra)
recurrenceNote: Available on request (not fixed public dates)
suitableFor: Couples; solo travellers; wellness seekers; small groups
accessibilityNotes: Farmhouse accommodation accessible, check with venue
nearbyAttractions: Peninsula Hot Springs; Many Little restaurant in Red Hill South; Flinders Truffles
suggestedItineraryPairing: Confirm retreat dates and programme directly. Plan any Polperro tasting or restaurant meal for Wednesday to Sunday; the restaurant and cellar door are closed Mondays and Tuesdays.
editorVerdict: A retreat that takes wellness seriously without the wellness-industrial-complex theatrics.
editorNote:
Three days, two nights at Polperro Farmhouse at 64 Donaldsons Road in Red Hill, separate from the winery and villas at 150 Red Hill Road. The format pairs yoga (outdoor in summer, studio in winter) with massage at Peninsula Hot Springs or Endota Red Hill, an optional acupressure workshop, and a Peninsula juice cleanse add-on. Run in partnership with Hut Yoga.

Who it's for: couples or solo travellers who want one weekend to genuinely reset, not a buffet of generic spa treatments. Pricing depends on inclusions; confirm when you call.

The practical move: dates are not fixed, so call Lauren at Polperro on (03) 5989 2471 Wednesday to Sunday, or email info@hutyoga.com.au, and build it around your calendar. Confirm the retreat dates and inclusions directly. Polperro Restaurant and Cellar Door are closed on Mondays and Tuesdays; plan any tasting or meal for a trading day and check service times before booking.
